faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Use the appointment form on the Contact page, call the clinic, or message us on Telegram. We will confirm your time with you.
Yes. Our pediatric service covers fillings, cleanings and baby tooth extraction, and kids braces are available.

faq.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faq.a: Call the clinic straight away. For a knocked-out tooth, keep the tooth moist and get to the clinic as quickly as you can.

faq.q: Do you offer braces for adults?
faq.a: Yes, braces and invisible aligners are available. An orthodontist will examine you and explain the options.
